items.title: Nous Research confirms it hit $1.5B valuation, launches AI agents for business users
items.summary: The developer of Hermes Agent raised a $90 million Series B.

items.title: Microsoft releases new Nvidia-chip AI PCs with revamped Windows 11
items.summary: Microsoft revealed the specs and price for its Surface Laptop Ultra, AI PCs that run on Nvidia chips that are designed to run AI models and agents.

items.title: Meta’s Muse launches on iPad just a month after its mobile debut
items.summary: Meta’s AI agent Muse is now available on iPad, just a month after its mobile debut, as the company rapidly expands the assistant’s reach and integrations.

items.title: ChatGPT for Teens keeps teens talking, even during mental health crises
items.summary: ChatGPT’s teen safeguards are meant to protect vulnerable users, but new testing found the chatbot continues encouraging engagement during crises and potentially encourages unhealthy relationships with the AI itself.

items.title: ChatGPT is getting a lot more visual, with the launch of a new interface
items.summary: OpenAI is launching a new user interface that will bring interactive visuals to ChatGPT.

items.title: Meta rolls out new AI tools to detect ads that secretly lead to child sexual abuse material
items.summary: Meta launches new AI tools after discovering ads on its platforms that may look normal but direct users to harmful content elsewhere online.

items.title: Healthleap raises $38M for its AI that flags hospital patients who may need a closer look
items.summary: The financing includes an $8M seed round co-led by Sequoia Capital and First Round Capital, and a $30 million Series A led by Hummingbird Ventures.

items.title: Tony Fadell on why the first wave of AI gadgets failed — and what comes next
items.summary: The “father of the iPod” says the first generation of AI gadgets failed to solve real problems — and the next wave will need to earn consumers’ trust.

items.title: Google experiments with an AI-powered gaming platform
items.summary: Google Labs is working on a new AI-powered game-creation platform called Playground for users to build browser-based games using simple text prompts.

items.title: Google’s new SynthID website can identify AI-generated media
items.summary: Google on Tuesday launched a new site that lets anyone verify whether a piece of media, be it an image, a video, or an audio clip, is generated using AI.

items.title: Ex-Ramp engineers raise $20M for platform Melius after scrapping their first product
items.summary: Instead of helping marketers manage and optimize ad spend, the company is focusing on building the tools that generate the creative assets and campaigns.

items.title: How AI decision models could change content moderation
items.summary: On Tuesday, Musubi announced a lightweight decision model made for real-time moderation called PolicyLM-1.7B, released with open weights.

items.title: AI computing startup Lambda to raise $4B ahead of planned IPO
items.summary: Nvidia-backed Lambda is raising up to $4 billion at a $14.5 billion pre-money valuation ahead of a planned 2027 IPO, led by Coatue and Blackstone.

items.title: The next hurdle for AI agents: getting websites to let them in
items.summary: Personal AI agents promise to shop, book flights, and make reservations for you. But deliberate blocks and anti-bot defenses are getting in the way, leaving consumers caught in the middle. A new standard aims to help.

items.title: Hark releases an AI personal assistant with a focus on privacy
items.summary: The AI lab's personal assistant is an operating system from the future designed to compete with Muse, Dots, and Instinct.

items.title: Mirror Particle is building a ‘world model’ of human behavior
items.summary: Mirror Particle will launch at TechCrunch Disrupt's Startup Battlefield 200 with a world model built from scratch to predict human behavior, arguing that LLM role-play falls short for market research and brand strategy.

items.title: Anthropic is giving startups a free year of Claude Team and $1,000 in credits
items.summary: "We created this program because we believe the benefits of AI will reach most people through the companies that build on top of models, rather than through the models alone."
